beats.says: A wave's height rises and falls.
beats.voice: A wave's height rises and falls.
beats.shows: axes grow from the origin, a faint grid draws out and dims, a sine plots left to right with a tracer and a height readout; the tracer slides back to the crest

beats.says: Height is the sine of distance, scaled by the swell, moving in time.
beats.voice: Height is the sine of distance, scaled by the swell, moving in time.
beats.shows: h = sin(x) builds token by token, then rewrites to h = A sin(x), then h = A sin(x − t); a key names h and x in their colours

beats.says: One turning circle traces the whole wave.
beats.voice: One turning circle traces the whole wave.
beats.shows: a circle turns a quarter and unrolls into one period of the wave, on a faint baseline
